title: Well Optimized
description: A carefully crafted collection of mods and packs that let you experience real smoothness, not just big numbers on the screen.
body:
**Well Optimized** is simple. We wanted the game to feel smooth in a real way, not fake boosted numbers that look nice but play like trash. So we tested a bunch of stuff, kept what actually helped, tossed what didn’t, and ended up with something that made our own gameplay feel clean and steady. It felt good, so we turned it into a pack. That’s pretty much the whole story. Oh, and we’ve added a few QoL improvements too, so everything feels smoother without turning into feature bloat.

This is our first release, so if you run into anything weird or have an idea that can make it even better, just drop it in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/4mTzMxvAtK). We actually read that stuff. Lastly, we’ll keep polishing it and fixing whatever shows up, so give it a shot! ^~^
